rules.text: I don't understand you anymore. You helped me, and then you hurt me.
I knew I couldn't trust you.
I want to believe you. Give me some time.
You say that, but I remember what happened.

actions.LIE: Something about your story doesn't add up.
actions.DEFEND: Thanks for standing up for me.
actions.BEFRIEND: It's good to have someone to talk to.
actions.BETRAY: I trusted you. That makes this worse.
actions.IGNORE: All right. I'll leave you to it.
actions.DISMISS: So my feelings don't matter to you?

accusations.STEAL: You stole from me. How do you explain that?
accusations.THREATEN: You threatened me. Why are you back?
accusations.BETRAY: You've got some nerve coming back after betraying me.
accusations.INSULT: You insulted me. What was that about?
accusations.LIE: You lied to me. I want an explanation.

greetings.CONFUSED: Some days you help me, other days you hurt me. I don't understand you.
greetings.SUSPICIOUS: What do you want this time?
